uḍḍīyānabandha
------------------------------------------
This is one of the exercises—known as mudrās or bandhas—prescribed by works on हठयोग for controlling the प्राण (vital air and energy) and make it move into the सुषुम्ना-nāḍī (canal). It consists mainly in contracting the muscles of the belly backwards towards the spine. It helps one to revitalise his energy.
The actual technique has to be learnt from an adept in the science (vide Haṭhayogapradīpikā 3.54-59).
